immaculately.linePrev: With his friend, a jealous monk
immaculately.line: Now he looked so immaculately frightful
stanza: With his memories in a trunk
Passed this way an hour ago
With his friend, a jealous monk
Now he looked so immaculately frightful
Then he went off sniffing drainpipes
You would not think to look at him
But he was famous long ago
So she'd stand out of the crowd
Daisy doesn't care from where she seeds
